title: [finding] lint.yml's comment above the corpus-claim-drift step still says the table carries the `$exists` family ONLY — false once #13745's three rows land
body:
Filed unassigned by the `domain:devx` execution seat while implementing #13745 (PR for `claude/issue-13745-corpus-claim-ratchet-rows`). ⛔ Ungraded, ⛔ unclaimed, ⛔ no `domain:*`.

## The stale claim

`.github/workflows/lint.yml`, in the comment block above the **Teaching-corpus lexical anti-drift ratchet** step (`run: pnpm check:corpus-claim-drift`), on `origin/main` today:

```
      # Table-driven by the #13582 triage ruling, carrying the `$exists` family
      # ONLY — each further word (the retired `$regex` spelling, #13532's
      # `visibleWhen` claims) pays its own baseline on its own card.
```

#13745 is that card, and it ships all three of the words this comment names as still outstanding: `exists-portability` (the `(NoSQL)` portability gloss), `regex-retired` and `section-visiblewhen-unbound`. Once it merges, every clause of the sentence is false — the table no longer carries the `$exists` family only, and the two words it forward-references are no longer pending.

The gate's own header, its `VOCABULARY` JSDoc and its `--self-test` enumeration are all updated by that PR. This one comment is not, because it lives in `.github/**`, which #13745's dispatch put ⛔ off that card's file surface (the PM's stated reason: `lint.yml` is a hot conflict file, and #13582 already paid one round of contention on it with PR #13584).

## Why it is worth a card rather than a shrug

Same class as #11551, #10045 and #10713 — a workflow comment that carried measured facts and drifted silently. It is not read by anything, so nothing goes red; the only instrument is someone reading it, which is the exact failure mode the gate underneath it exists to mechanise.

## The correcting wording, offered not imposed

```
      # Table-driven by the #13582 triage ruling. #13582 shipped the `$exists`
      # family alone; #13745 added the `(NoSQL)` portability gloss, the retired
      # `$regex` spelling and #13532's `visibleWhen` claims, each with its own
      # legitimate-usage survey. Each further word pays its own baseline on its
      # own card, and the gate's `--self-test` pins the shipped row set as an
      # exact enumeration.
```

⚠️ Sequencing: this is only true once #13745's PR merges. Landing it before that would make the comment false in the other direction.
